cloud.evidence: unverified 2026-09-04: grok --help (demo box, grok 1.0.13) names remote sessions only on the resume path: `--restore-code  Restore the original session's repository snapshot when resuming. harnesses.name: Codex

effort.evidence: codex --help (demo box, codex-cli 0.153.0, 2026-09-06): `-c, --config <key=value>  Override a configuration value that would otherwise be loaded from ~/.codex/config.toml`, example `-c model="o3"`; the key model_reasoning_effort is the one ~/.codex/config.toml carries on this box (`model_reasoning_effort = "medium"`), which is what a codex pane launched without it showed (`gpt-6-astra medium`, 2026-09-06). more-reasoning has no vendor value and stays recorded, not applied. xhigh is accepted as-is because it is the vendor's own value (vendor_values), 2026-09-06 spec: 'two gpt-5.6-luna xhigh'

harnesses.models_evidence: unverified 2026-09-04: codex --help (demo box, codex-cli 0.153.0) -m/--model <MODEL> 'Model the agent should use'; no enumeration

cloud.evidence: codex --help (demo box, codex-cli 0.153.0, 2026-09-04): `cloud  [EXPERIMENTAL] Browse tasks from Codex Cloud and apply changes locally`; codex cloud --help lists `codex cloud exec` as `exec  Submit a new Codex Cloud task without launching the TUI`, plus status, list, apply, diff. A submitted task, not an interactive session. `--remote <ADDR>  Connect the TUI to a remote app server endpoint` is a self-hosted app server, not Codex Cloud

harnesses.model_flag_evidence: codex --help and codex resume --help (demo box, codex-cli 0.153.0, 2026-09-06): -m/--model <MODEL> 'Model the agent should use'; live 2026-09-06 a relaunched codex pane without it booted ~/.codex/config.toml's model (gpt-6-astra) instead of the seat's gpt-5.6

harnesses.name: Cursor-Agent

effort.evidence: cursor-agent --help (this box, 2026.08.11-e8db854, 2026-09-08): there is no effort flag; effort rides the model id (gpt-5.3-codex-xhigh, claude-opus-5-low) or a bracket override on --model ('claude-opus-4-8[effort=high]'). Convoy records a declared effort and never emits it

harnesses.models_evidence: unverified 2026-09-08: `cursor-agent models` on this box (Pro+ login) printed a per-account list of ~40 ids (auto, gpt-5.3-codex-*, gpt-5.6-luna-high, gpt-5.6-sol-*, claude-opus-5-*, claude-sonnet-5-*, claude-fable-5-*, cursor-grok-4.6-*, composer-2.5, gemini-3.7-flash-high); effort is baked into the id (…-low/-medium/-high/-xhigh, …-fast). The list is per account and Convoy does not call it, so the catalog stays a field, not a menu

cloud.evidence: cursor-agent --help (this box, 2026.08.11-e8db854, 2026-09-08): `worker  Start a private cloud worker that connects to Cursor to run agents in your environment` is a self-hosted worker, not a cloud session; no option creates or attaches a Cursor cloud session from this CLI
